page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-192 is an enterprise-grade virtual server featuring an x86_64 architecture powered by the Intel Xeon 8581C processor clocked at 2.3 GHz. The instance delivers 192 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 96 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The memory footprint comprises 1488 GB of RAM, offering approximately 7.75 GB per vCPU. Cache infrastructure includes 48 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and a large 260 MB shared L3 cache array. Advanced CPU capabilities include AVX-512, AMX tile and int8 matrix execution engines, and cryptographic acceleration via AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

The instance provides no bundled local disk storage and zero discrete GPUs. Persistent storage requirements must be fulfilled via network-attached cloud storage services. Furthermore, the configuration provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which requires explicit virtual private cloud routing or secondary network allocations for external network accessibility.

Benchmark profiles indicate top-decile multi-core processing efficiency, validated by a multi-core stress-ng throughput score of 165304.41 and a PassMark CPU score of 131185.99. Read memory bandwidth reaches 574.78 GB/sec on uncached large-block evaluations, while write bandwidth achieves 245.51 GB/sec. Application testing demonstrates high concurrency handling, posting 169.92 million operations per second in Redis SET workloads and upper-tier PassMark database metric evaluations. Single-core throughput is balanced, aligning with median baseline expectations on stress-ng tests.

With substantial memory capacity paired with 96 physical Intel Xeon cores, the c4n-highmem-192 provides strong resource density for memory-bound and multi-threaded enterprise applications. It is tailored for large-scale in-memory databases, Redis distributed caching, enterprise transactional processing, and memory-intensive data analytics.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-192 is an x86_64 server powered by an Intel Xeon 8581C processor running at 2.3 GHz, featuring 192 dedicated vCPUs across 96 physical cores and 1488 GB of RAM. The instance incorporates 260 MB of L3 cache along with hardware-assisted instruction sets including Intel AMX and AVX-512. It contains no onboard GPUs and offers no bundled local NVMe storage, relying on external network volumes for persistent storage. Benchmark data places the system in the top tier for multi-core compute, large-block memory bandwidth, and high-concurrency database tests, recording 169.92 million Redis SET operations per second. Single-core performance sits in the middle tier. With 7.75 GB of RAM per vCPU, the c4n-highmem-192 is designed for large in-memory databases, distributed key-value caches, high-concurrency database deployments, and parallel analytics workflows.
